name: ignis-monorepo
description: Zero-dependency browser-native WebGPU LLM & Full-Omni multimodal inference engine (Spark, LFM3-Omni, Gemma 4, Qwen/Llama)

scripts.build:wasm: cd tokenizer && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ignis_tokenizer.wasm ../runtime/wasm/ignis_tokenizer.wasm -Force"
scripts.pack:check: node packages/core/scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node packages/packer/scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node tests/ci-pack-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:phase6: node tests/test-phase6-degradation.mjs && node tests/test-phase6-fsm.mjs && node tests/test-phase6-speculative.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/probe.mjs && node tests/test-kernels.mjs && node tests/test-tokenizer.mjs && node tests/phase2-numerical.mjs && node tests/phase3-e2e.mjs && node tests/phase5-multiarch.mjs

author: Ray-D-Song
